digest.component_or_area: config ownership / seam boundary enforcement (RP-04 S7.3.f)
propositions: Eleven below-seam ambient config/credential reads across 9 files (_logging, _opcert_signing, _operation_config, mirror_guard, review_bot/app, signing, grounding/harness, grounding/oracle, grounding/resolve) remain registered in LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS and must be eliminated.

Each below-seam read must be either routed through an approved composition seam (OperationSnapshot, startup binding, or provider-credential boundary) or annotated in-place with an inline read-via marker for kill-switch/test-only controls.
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for the 9 affected files must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py such that check_config_ownership.py reports zero findings for those paths.
Subsystem behavioral suites (signing, opcert, logging, grounding) must remain green after the cutover, with operation-snapshot fingerprints unchanged except for approved recorded deltas.
The 2 residual binding_lifecycle.py rows (RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE and _env_int parser) are out-of-scope and owned by RP-04 S7.3.a / ticket 01d8-c18d-b229-419a.
Held-out test test_residual_drain_seam_clean_heldout.py must verify no seam-violation findings exist for the 9 paths and no path remains in LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS.
